sloka: ततः प्रव्यथिताः सर्वे देवाः स अग्नि पुरोगमाः ।अब्रुवन् वचनम् सर्वे परस्पर समागताः ॥३-११-१३॥
transliteration: tataḥ pravyathitāḥ sarve devāḥ sa agni purogamāḥ ।abruvan vacanam sarve paraspara samāgatāḥ ॥3-11-13॥

translations.english: Thereafter very much perturbed, all the gods led by Agni gathered together at one place and started deliberating among themselves.
